from pathlib import Path
import sys,json
sys.path.insert(0,'/Users/admin/src/light-cljs/tests/reference/compiler-language')
import sci_execution as sci
import sci_originals_after190_candidates as current
import sci_gap_return_candidates as historical
IDS=('sci-record-redefine','sci-record-numeric-key','sci-record-method-recur','sci-extension-recur')
root=Path('/private/tmp/light-cljs-125-record-inspection-after190-v1');root.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
originals=sci.rows(sci.CORPUS);dispositions=sci.rows(sci.DISPOSITIONS);cases=[]
for identity in IDS:
 line,fields=dispositions[identity];oldline,old=originals[identity]
 if fields[:7]!=old or fields[2]!=fields[8] or fields[1]!='portable' or fields[7]!='gap':raise ValueError('Unadapted original record source/profile drift')
 cases.append({'id':'sci-execution-'+identity,'sci_id':identity,'obligation_id':'local::tests/reference/sci/evaluator-dispositions.tsv::'+identity,'body_sha256':sci.digest(line),'original_row_sha256':sci.digest(oldline),'source_sha256':sci.digest(old[2]),'original_source_sha256':sci.digest(old[2]),'source':old[2],'original_fields':old,'expected':sci.expected(old),'isolated':True,'reference_isolated':True,'setup':'Unchanged complete portable declaration/method/constructor/recur source, lexical observe, captured streaming stdout and original empty stderr; no source-name alias, host/library/reader fixture or reduced witness.'})
(root/'sources.json').write_text(json.dumps(cases,indent=2)+'\n');before=historical.snapshot();bindings=current.reference_execution_binding();evidence={r['id']:{} for r in cases}
for kind in ('local','release','checkout'):
 layers=sci.local_cases(cases,root/kind,300) if kind=='local' else sci.reference_cases(cases,kind,sci.ROOT/'research/clojurescript',root/kind,600)
 for identity,layer in layers.items():evidence[identity][kind]=layer
 print(kind,{identity:layer['status'] for identity,layer in layers.items()},flush=True)
if before!=historical.snapshot() or bindings!=current.reference_execution_binding():raise ValueError('Read-only record inspection input/compiler/executable drift')
receipt={'schema_version':1,'scope':'Read-only complete unadapted original record inspection; no current source/phase/ledger credit','original_semantic_pass_credit':0,'producer_source_sha256':before,'reference_execution_binding':bindings,'script_sha256':sci.digest(Path(__file__).read_bytes()),'source_bindings':cases,'evidence':evidence,'artifact_sha256':{str(p.relative_to(root)):sci.digest(p.read_bytes()) for p in sorted(root.rglob('*')) if p.is_file()}}
(root/'evidence.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+'\n')
